title: Digital Health Innovation Canvas
description: JSON schema for a filled Digital Health Innovation Canvas. See canvas.md for the reasoning behind each field, and canvas-template.md for the human-fillable equivalent. Field order below matches the intended fill order: metadata, then the Governance Spine (checked first, before Discover), then Discover, Design, Deliver, then the Value Anchor five aims.

metadata.description: Header fields every canvas carries, filled before any section.

innovationName.description: The initiative this canvas belongs to.

author.description: Who filled this canvas in, and is accountable for keeping it current. Labeled 'Author By' in the markdown template.

date.description: Date last filled or revisited, YYYY-MM-DD.

sections.description: Governance Spine fields are checked first and gate everything below. Discover, Design, and Deliver are phases, in order. Value Anchor fields are revisited at every phase.

gov_regulatory.title: Regulatory Pathway
gov_regulatory.description: Governance Spine, pillar 1. Classification (SaMD/SiMD/wellness), risk tier, regulatory sandbox or pre-market pathway (name the gap if none exists in-country), local-content/procurement constraints, and quality/safety standards in scope (ISO 13485, IEC 62304, ISO 14971).

gov_clinical.title: Clinical Governance
gov_clinical.description: Governance Spine, pillar 2. Governing clinical/treatment protocol, patient safety model, adverse-event/near-miss reporting pathway.

gov_data.title: Data Governance
gov_data.description: Governance Spine, pillar 3. Legal basis for data processing (name the gap if no sector-specific law applies), consent model, security/residency, data fate if the project or organisation ends.

gov_tech.title: Tech Governance
gov_tech.description: Governance Spine, pillar 4. Architecture and interoperability (national HMIS/DHIS2/FHIR or other standards), cybersecurity controls, API model, disaster recovery/business continuity.

disc_challenge.title: Health Challenge
disc_challenge.description: Discover, 1 of 3. The health-system problem in the owning institution's own terms, its mechanism and barriers, and alignment with national health strategy/SDGs.

disc_users.title: User Profiles
disc_users.description: Discover, 2 of 3. Primary users, demographic/digital-literacy profile, behaviours and workarounds, urban/rural and connectivity assumptions.

disc_stakeholders.title: Stakeholder Map
disc_stakeholders.description: Discover, 3 of 3. Relevant government bodies, clinical/professional bodies, payers, industry/academic partners, and the accountable owner.

des_arch.title: Solution Architecture
des_arch.description: Design, 1 of 3. Which pillar the solution sits in, and whether it matches the classification already named in the Governance Spine.

des_ux.title: User Experience
des_ux.description: Design, 2 of 3. Core features reduced to the Discover-stage minimum, and accessibility (language, modality, offline/connectivity assumptions).

des_integration.title: Enterprise Interoperability
des_integration.description: Design, 3 of 3. Integration with the national platform layer and facility-level systems, terminology coding, offline-sync requirements.

del_evidence.title: Evidence Plan
del_evidence.description: Deliver, 1 of 3. Evidence pathway and endpoints, study design, sample size, cost-effectiveness metrics.

del_scale.title: Scale Strategy
del_scale.description: Deliver, 2 of 3. Go-to-market/go-to-government strategy, change management, national-scale pathway and its decision owner.

del_business.title: Business Model
del_business.description: Deliver, 3 of 3. Revenue/sustainability model, insurance/reimbursement pathway if relevant, unit economics at scale.

val_equity.title: Health Equity
val_equity.description: Value Anchor. Does this work as well for the hardest-to-reach population as for the easiest pilot site?

val_population.title: Population Health
val_population.description: Value Anchor. Does this move a population-level indicator, not just an individual encounter?

val_patient.title: Patient Experience
val_patient.description: Value Anchor. Is this better for the person receiving care?

val_provider.title: Provider Satisfaction
val_provider.description: Value Anchor. Does this reduce or add to the health worker's workload and cognitive burden?

val_cost.title: Cost Reduction
val_cost.description: Value Anchor. What is the true cost of running this at scale, not the pilot-budget cost?
